Owner's equity"}, {"bbox": [859, 127, 874, 494], "category": "Section-header", "text": "a. Recognition of owner's capital contribution and share premium"}, {"bbox": [822, 127, 855, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Owner's investment capital is recorded according to the actual capital contributed by the owner and is tracked in detail for each organization and individual."}, {"bbox": [785, 127, 817, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Share premium is recorded as the greater or lesser difference between the actual issue price and the par value of the shares."}, {"bbox": [763, 127, 778, 342], "category": "Section-header", "text": "b. Recognition of undistributed profits"}, {"bbox": [712, 127, 757, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Undistributed earnings are the profit of business operations after addition (+) or deduction (-) of regulated items due to applying a change in accounting retrospectively or to make a retrospective restatement to correct materiality in previous year."}, {"bbox": [690, 127, 705, 497], "category": "Text", "text": "Profit distribution must be complied with the current financial policies."}, {"bbox": [608, 127, 684, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Parent Company distributes profit to owners which shall not exceed the undistributed post-tax profits on the consolidated financial statements, including the impact of any gain recognized from bargain purchase transactions. In case undistributed post-tax profits in the consolidated financial statements is higher than its financial statements of the parent company, the parent company makes distribution after transferring profits from subsidiary companies to the parent companies."}, {"bbox": [571, 127, 603, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Profit distribution should take account of non-monetary items in undistributed post-tax profits that may affect cash flows and the dividend payment ability of the Company."}, {"bbox": [541, 97, 556, 256], "category": "Section-header", "text": "18. Recognition of revenue"}, {"bbox": [518, 127, 533, 293], "category": "Section-header", "text": "a. Revenue from sale of goods"}, {"bbox": [496, 127, 511, 580], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue from sales of goods is recognized when the following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [474, 127, 489, 636], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The significant risks and rewards of ownership of the goods have been transferred to the buyer;"}, {"bbox": [446, 127, 478, 666], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The Group retains neither continuing managerial involvement as a neither owner nor effective control over the goods sold;"}, {"bbox": [424, 127, 439, 355], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The amount of revenue can be measured;"}, {"bbox": [394, 127, 424, 666], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The economic benefits associated with the transaction of goods sold have flown or will flow to the Group;"}, {"bbox": [358, 127, 390, 666], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The costs incurred or to be incurred in respect of the transaction of goods sold can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [336, 127, 351, 339], "category": "Section-header", "text": "b. Revenue from rendering of services"}, {"bbox": [300, 127, 332, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue from rendering of services should be recognised when all the following conditions have been satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [278, 127, 293, 398], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The amount of revenue can be measured reliably;"}, {"bbox": [256, 127, 271, 636], "category": "List-item", "text": "- It is probable that the economic benefit associated with the transaction will flow to the Group;"}, {"bbox": [236, 127, 251, 666], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The stage of completion of the transaction at the Consolidated Balance sheet date can be measured reliably;"}, {"bbox": [204, 127, 234, 666], "category": "List-item", "text": "- The costs incurred for the transaction and the costs to complete the transaction can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [182, 127, 197, 317], "category": "Section-header", "text": "c. Revenue from sale of real estate"}, {"bbox": [127, 127, 173, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue is recognized when the material risks and ownership rights have transferred to the buyer, which usually coincides with the unconditional delivery of the contracts. For a conditional transfer, revenue is recognized only when all material conditions are satisfied."}, {"bbox": [603, 676, 726, 726], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [47, 373, 62, 387], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "20"}]
